verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly shows a central Unreal Editor in which Levels are loaded, tested from the toolbar, and populated with Actors. Reflection metadata specifiers expose C++ properties as editor functionality, and a community user describes building lit environments in it. However, the specific viewport, inspector and prefab/scene-composition workflow is only implied, never documented directly, and one community comment calls the editor UI clunky and dated. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the level viewport, Details/inspector panel and prefab-style reusable actor composition, plus hands-on corroboration that visual level building is the primary workflow.
